labels.symptom: There is no web (WASM) version of the app.
Cannot open native project files from the commercial original.
There is no advanced color management or OpenColorIO support.
Many shape layer features and content editing shortcuts are missing.
On macOS 27 with Apple Silicon the app starts, never opens a window, and quits silently after about 10 seconds.
Camera depth of field is much weaker than the F-stop suggests, and changing the focal length doesn't update the aperture.
labels.root_cause: The aperture is computed from the F-stop with the wrong scale and isn't recomputed when the focal length changes.

labels.symptom: Reflective 3D surfaces don't reflect other objects, and the Environment light type is missing from the layer.newLight help.
labels.root_cause: Nothing in the renderer reads appearsInReflections, and the help text was never updated with the Environment light.

labels.symptom: Dragging files onto the window does nothing on some machines, though it works on others.
Request for layer groups, a reorderable render stack, world-space layer sampling and other compositing workflows.
Exported files sometimes get a project file extension added, and ProRes alpha exports with motion blur fail to decode in other apps.
Mesh Warp shows no grid in the viewer, so it cannot be used to warp anything.
There is no smooth real-time GPU playback mode; playback depends on processing frames into RAM.
Imported 3D models look flat and the composition still reports Classic 3D after switching to Advanced 3D.
No automatic transcription to generate captions.
3D text layers have no front, bevel, side and back material options.
Clicking the align-left text button aligns text right, and align-right aligns it left.
Users want to load third-party effect plugins.
Exporting over an existing file reports success but the old file stays on disk.
labels.root_cause: A failed overwrite (possibly on a cloud-synced folder) is not detected or reported.

labels.symptom: On Windows the taskbar icon and small or medium Explorer icons appear as blank white documents.
labels.root_cause: The Windows exe icon resource likely lacks small sizes and the window icon is not set at runtime.

labels.symptom: There is no support for OpenFX plugins.
Scrubbing or clicking through a long video on the timeline takes several seconds to update the viewer.
No OLM Smoother-style smoothing effect is available.
Third-party plug-ins and scripts are not supported.
A composition made from a video has one-frame audio gaps that crackle and drift when rendered.
ProRes 4444 exports are tagged as bt709 but the pixels are encoded with the sRGB curve.
labels.root_cause: The exporter applies the sRGB transfer function but writes bt709 transfer metadata.

labels.symptom: On Intel Macs, quitting from the app menu crashes and produces a macOS problem report.
3D objects cannot be moved, rotated or scaled with on-canvas tools, only by typing numbers.
No automatic sway or rig tool for 2D hair, cloth and characters.
Many media formats cannot be imported or exported.
Expressions cannot be edited in an external code editor.
Motion graphics compositions cannot be live-linked into the video editor timeline; every change needs a re-render and re-import.
Changing the Motion Tile effect's output width and height has no visible effect.
There is no option to export uncompressed RGBA video in a single container file like AVI or MOV.
Requests Discord Rich Presence, import of Premiere Pro project files and exportable crash reports.
There is no interface to list, enable, disable or install plug-ins.
After a crash there is no way to save or copy a diagnostic report.
There is no opt-in Discord Rich Presence.
Selected 3D layers, cameras and lights have no interactive move/rotate/scale handles in the viewer.
4K and log footage cannot be previewed.
Text in the zoomed-out viewer looks soft or jagged at Fit zoom.
labels.root_cause: Auto resolution drops to Half, and minification uses a bilinear sampler without mipmaps.

labels.symptom: Keyframes are hard to tell apart, and you can't put markers on the timeline.
The app crashes with no message when scrubbing the timeline or during playback.
The UI has no extra languages, text cannot be customized, and timeline dragging lags behind the pointer.
Chinese text displays incorrectly or as missing glyphs.
labels.root_cause: Probably no CJK font fallback in the bundled fonts.

labels.symptom: The Curl Noise effect renders a blank, transparent result.
On macOS, shortcuts with Shift can't be assigned, the timeline doesn't pan when the playhead is dragged to its edge, and deleting a mask turns the layer black.
The Cryptomatte selection can't be set in the effect controls or by clicking in the viewer, and GPU rendering takes about 9 seconds per 1440p frame.
labels.root_cause: The Selection property has no value widget and there is no viewer picking; the GPU path is slow.

labels.symptom: Multi-layer EXR files without an unnamed RGB layer render many times slower and use far more memory than single-layer EXRs, especially with channel-extraction effects.
labels.root_cause: Every channel of the multi-layer EXR is decoded more than once per frame, once for each consumer.

labels.symptom: OpenEXR files with HTJ2K compression either fail to import with a misleading channel error or import and render as blank.
labels.root_cause: The EXR decoder doesn't support HTJ2K compression and doesn't report it as unsupported.
bug_markers: image does not contain non-deep rgb channels

labels.symptom: On Linux, panels can't be moved outside the main window onto other monitors.
labels.root_cause: Panels are drawn inside the single main window instead of as separate OS windows.

labels.symptom: While renaming an item, the arrow keys move to the next item instead of moving the cursor in the name.
labels.root_cause: List keyboard navigation takes the arrow keys before the text field being edited gets them.

labels.symptom: Dragging a layer by its anchor point does not move the layer.
There is no optional Nvidia CUDA/NVENC path for faster effects and exports.
On Windows with an AMD GPU the app crashes at startup inside the AMD OpenGL driver (atio6axx.dll).
labels.root_cause: GPU setup at startup loads the AMD OpenGL driver, and the driver crashes with an access violation.

labels.symptom: Audio starts late when playback doesn't begin at the start of the timeline, and video audio stutters.
Pixel Motion Blur shows separated copies of moving content instead of blur, and Vector Detail has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The renderer averages fetched frames without warping by motion vectors and never reads the Vector Detail parameter.

labels.symptom: Font style, size and color controls are missing from the toolbar for text layers, and font previews overflow the character panel dropdown.
Shift+Space preview skips frames by default, so playback looks stuttery.
labels.root_cause: The preview preference defaults to skipping 1 frame.

labels.symptom: On macOS, saving or exporting fails with a read-only file system error that is shown only in a hover tooltip and gives no guidance about permissions.
labels.root_cause: macOS sandbox and file permission errors (os error 30) are not detected or clearly shown to the user.

labels.symptom: Pressing Ctrl/Cmd plus or minus over the canvas or viewer does not zoom in or out.
labels.root_cause: The zoom keyboard shortcuts are not bound for the focused viewport.

labels.symptom: Adjusting pan or tilt on the chromatic aberration effect crashes the app.
Dragging puppet pins in the preview lags.
The app can't be installed from the Microsoft Store.
Playback stutters even on cached frames, frames just ahead of the playhead never get cached, and cache indicators disappear at lower viewer resolution.
Advanced effects like those in third-party plugins are missing, and those plugins can't be loaded.
Nested compositions cannot be expanded and edited in place in the parent timeline.
A layer's masks, effects and transform always render in a fixed order that cannot be changed.
Effect layer parameters can only sample the chosen layer in its own space, not in comp space.
Effects, masks and styles cannot be set to preview only or render only.
Vector documents from the companion app cannot be imported.
Gradients cannot be edited: the Edit Gradient button and the gradient preview do nothing when clicked.
On Windows when the GPU device is DirectX 12, GPU compute acceleration fails to start and rendering silently falls back to the CPU.
labels.root_cause: The FXC shader compiler aborts when it compiles a WGSL compute kernel that uses pow() with a possibly negative base.

labels.symptom: After duplicating a text layer, neither the original nor the copy can be edited.
Request to support the Duik rigging toolset or a scripting API strong enough to run it.
Double-clicking a precomposed layer does not open it in its own composition tab.
On macOS, imported audio and video play silent and invisible in the preview and are missing from renders.
The smear effect does not trail off like a liquid when its amount goes beyond 100%.
The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: No guided setup flow exists in the desktop UI.

labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Windows, AppImage and Flatpak packages don't put the CLI on PATH, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: The composition viewer cannot show two or four views side by side, such as a Top view next to the Active Camera view.
Dropping a PSD file onto the window imports it without showing the import options dialog that the menu command shows.
labels.root_cause: The drag-and-drop import path skips the PSD import dialog used by the menu command.

labels.symptom: An automation or MCP agent can change the preference that gates script capabilities without user confirmation.
labels.root_cause: Scripting-related preferences can be changed through the automation command path.

labels.symptom: The app inside the macOS release dmg fails strict codesign verification because of Finder information detritus.
labels.root_cause: Empty com.apple.FinderInfo extended attributes on bundle resources are not removed before signing.

labels.symptom: A Brightness & Contrast layer imported from a layered PSD renders differently from the flattened reference.
UI scale can only be set in fixed steps in settings, with no keyboard shortcut and no custom value.
labels.root_cause: The Ctrl +/- zoom shortcut was removed and the settings only offer preset scale values.

labels.symptom: Import File has no 'import as sequence' option, so selecting a numbered image sequence imports separate files.
Dragging media into an empty composition panel does not create a matching composition.
Dragging several media files into a composition adds only the first one.
GPU compositing of large comps with effect stacks is slow because pixels are copied back and forth and textures are reallocated every frame.
labels.root_cause: Effect stacks round-trip through the CPU, pooled textures aren't reused within a frame, footprint cache keys include time-dependent effects, and the upload cache evicts silently.

labels.symptom: Audio is re-rendered on every playback even when unchanged, so playback from the start stutters and the audio lags.
labels.root_cause: Rendered audio is not cached or checked for changes before rendering again.

labels.symptom: With Traditional Chinese selected, parts of the interface still show English.
labels.root_cause: The translation catalog is incomplete.

labels.symptom: Some UI elements are not drawn flat and look out of place against the rest of the theme.
There is no built-in rolling-number text effect or multi-pass glow effect.
Saved workspaces don't persist or don't load, at least in the AppImage build.
The speed of shape path values can't be edited in the graph editor.
Red Giant-style effects are not available.
The CC Cylinder effect lacks X, Y and Z rotation parameters.
Auto-save lacks configurable interval, version limits, safe crash recovery and saving versions to storage the user owns.
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: With time display set to Frames, the timeline ruler still labels ticks in seconds:frames.
labels.root_cause: The timeline ruler's label format is hardcoded as seconds:frames and ignores the time display setting.

labels.symptom: The color picker popup has no eyedropper for sampling colors from the canvas, and no hex field or alpha slider.
labels.root_cause: The shared color button widget is not connected to the existing canvas sampling mechanism.

labels.symptom: Footage preview is slow, and scrubbing or zooming the timeline lags in long compositions.
Dragging several selected assets into the timeline adds only one of them instead of all.
Applying Cryptomatte to an EXR sequence uses far too much memory.
There is no Ctrl+Space quick-apply command bar for searching and adding layers or effects.
WebP files with an alpha channel make the app freeze and keep caching frames forever.
A question about using the -craft name for an independent project.
Holding Shift while dragging Graph Editor handles does not lock the movement to one axis.
labels.root_cause: The handle drag does not apply a Shift axis constraint.

labels.symptom: There is no Flow-style easing curve tool for animations.
Copying and pasting several keyframes at once does not work.
STL 3D model files are refused on import.
labels.root_cause: There is no STL reader; only glTF and OBJ are supported.

labels.symptom: There is no command to copy the current frame to the clipboard as an image.
An object's fill and stroke type can't be changed or removed from the top options bar.
FBX 3D model files are rejected on import.
Pasting SVG markup from the system clipboard does nothing instead of creating an editable shape layer.
labels.root_cause: Paste only reads the app's internal clipboard.

labels.symptom: The font menu cannot be filtered to show only variable fonts.
Targa and Radiance HDR files appear in the media browser but fail to import.
labels.root_cause: The importable-extension list and the still decoder do not handle .tga or .hdr.

labels.symptom: Agents using the sandboxed MCP server cannot run loops or scripts.
A reopened project always opens on its first composition instead of the one that was active when it was saved.
labels.root_cause: The project file does not store the active composition.

labels.symptom: Agents cannot preview motion, and some MCP tools treat numeric ids as names.
labels.root_cause: Some MCP tools resolve layer and comp arguments only by name, not by numeric id.

labels.symptom: Float footage ignores the Working Gamma setting and gets gamma-encoded twice when interpreted as linear light.
labels.root_cause: Float footage is sRGB-encoded at decode time, and the Interpret As Linear Light setting then encodes it a second time.

labels.symptom: Shape layers that are scaled up look blurry unless Collapse Transformations is on.
labels.root_cause: Shape layers are rasterised at 100% scale and then enlarged, instead of being rasterised at the final transformed size.

labels.symptom: The Layer viewer can't be zoomed, zoom commands change the Composition viewer instead, and Roto Brush does nothing in the Composition viewer.
labels.root_cause: Zoom input and commands go to the Composition viewer's state, and the Layer viewer has no zoom state of its own.

labels.symptom: DPX and Cineon files show up in the media browser but don't import.
labels.root_cause: media::is_importable rejects .dpx and .cin, and there is no decoder for them.

labels.symptom: Effects & Presets has no Transitions category of animation presets.
Scripts that call property groups as functions fail with 'not a callable function'.
labels.root_cause: Layer, PropertyGroup and Property script objects can't be called as functions.

labels.symptom: Scripts using #include directives fail at the first include.
labels.root_cause: The script preprocessor does not handle #include, //@include or #includepath.

labels.symptom: Scripts that call $.evalFile or check BridgeTalk to identify the host fail during initialisation.
labels.root_cause: The scripting host has no BridgeTalk object and only a partial $.evalFile.

labels.symptom: An animated WebP imports as a still showing only its first frame.
labels.root_cause: The WebP import path does not read animation frames.

labels.symptom: Script panels never receive mouse events.
labels.root_cause: The scripting host does not dispatch mouse events to ScriptUI.

labels.symptom: MXF footage is listed in the Media Browser but cannot be imported.
labels.root_cause: media::is_importable rejects .mxf.

labels.symptom: Scrubbing a value with Ctrl+Alt across selected layers changes every layer by the same amount instead of spreading the change proportionally.
Scheduled script tasks set to repeat never run.
labels.root_cause: eval_with_tasks skips any task that has repeat set.

labels.symptom: In a panel, the arrow keys don't move the selection, focused rows show no focus ring, and screen readers announce nothing useful.
labels.root_cause: Custom-drawn widgets don't give AccessKit a name or role, and the panel doesn't handle arrow keys.

labels.symptom: You can't drag a selection box over the timeline to select several items; you have to click each one.
labels.root_cause: The timeline has no marquee selection.

labels.symptom: A damaged or hostile project file can crash the app instead of showing an error.
labels.root_cause: The project file readers have no fuzz coverage, and the XML reader recurses with no depth limit.

labels.symptom: There is no way to click an object and get a matte that follows it through the shot.
Malformed expressions can crash, hang or exhaust memory during rendering.
labels.root_cause: The expression parser and evaluator have never been tested against hostile input.

labels.symptom: Opening a corrupt or hostile project with huge dimensions or frame rates can trigger huge allocations or crashes.
labels.root_cause: Project loading does not clamp sizes, frame rates, durations and sample counts the way the create commands do.

labels.symptom: Importing a Premiere Pro project doesn't work.
Opening a long video uses RAM equal to the whole file size, doubled during import.
labels.root_cause: Probing and the media pool call std::fs::read on the whole file instead of opening the container in place.

labels.symptom: Footage dragged onto the timeline is cut to the composition length instead of keeping its full duration.
Keyboard shortcuts do nothing when a non-Latin keyboard layout such as Arabic is active.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut matching uses the layout's logical character instead of the physical key code.

labels.symptom: Video is decoded only in software, so H.264/HEVC playback is slow compared to hardware decoding.
labels.root_cause: The app pins an older FilmCraft version that does not include the hardware decoder platform crate.

labels.symptom: Video export cannot use GPU hardware encoders such as NVENC, QuickSync, AMF or VA-API.
Setting a layer comment, setting marker parameters, or calling sourcePointToComp from a script does nothing and shows no error.
labels.root_cause: The prelude has no comment setter, and it only sends the marker cuePoint when the marker has a name.

labels.symptom: In expressions layer.source is undefined, layers picked through a Layer Control have no transform, and expression errors are not reported.
labels.root_cause: The expression layer objects are missing properties, and errors are swallowed without setting expressionError.

labels.symptom: An undo group with more commands than the undo-levels setting cannot be undone in one step.
labels.root_cause: Each command inside a group uses up its own level of the undo history.

labels.symptom: In scripts, comparing the same layer, comp or item with === always gives false.
labels.root_cause: Every property access builds a new wrapper object instead of returning a cached one.

labels.symptom: Scripts that run a hard-coded menu command id trigger the wrong command, for example 16 does not undo.
labels.root_cause: executeCommand reads the number as an index into the app's own command list instead of a stable id table.

labels.symptom: Scripts cannot replace a layer's source, swap footage for an image sequence, or set proxies.
labels.root_cause: The scripting prelude leaves replaceSource unimplemented and doesn't expose the existing footage and proxy commands.

labels.symptom: Removing keyframes one by one gets slower with each key, taking seconds for a thousand keys.
labels.root_cause: removeKey cost is linear in key count, making bulk removal quadratic.

labels.symptom: Scripts using After Effects matchNames for stroke dashes and text path options get null or errors.
labels.root_cause: Property groups use internal names instead of After Effects matchNames.
bug_markers: Can not add a property to "Dashes"

labels.symptom: Several common After Effects scripting APIs are missing or return undefined.
labels.root_cause: Scripting compatibility layer lacks these APIs.

labels.symptom: Scripts reading or writing files in binary mode corrupt bytes like 0x89 into replacement characters.
labels.root_cause: Script File I/O always decodes and encodes as UTF-8, ignoring BINARY encoding.

labels.symptom: Saving the project before starting a render makes the render never start and the app freeze.
Effect names and the Effect menu stay in English when the interface is set to another language.
labels.root_cause: Effect names are static strings that aren't routed through the translation catalog.

labels.symptom: The GPU Information window in Preferences jumps around and flickers.
With the text tool active, pressing Space types a space instead of starting playback even after clicking elsewhere.
labels.root_cause: Text editing keeps keyboard focus after the user clicks outside the text.

labels.symptom: Importing a multi-layer SVG creates a single merged layer.
SVG files with sequential numbered names are imported as one broken image sequence.
labels.root_cause: Image-sequence detection applies to SVG files based on numbered filenames.

labels.symptom: The puppet tool lags heavily in a composition with several PSD layers.
A text range selector added from a script is ignored when rendering, and its After Effects match names return null.
labels.root_cause: Selectors added from scripts aren't connected to the renderer, and ADBE match names aren't mapped to the native property names.

labels.symptom: A layered PSD imported from a script comes in flattened instead of as a composition with its layers.
labels.root_cause: The scripting ImportOptions.importAs setting is not passed through to the import.

labels.symptom: The particle effect renders an opaque background instead of particles on transparency.
labels.root_cause: The effect output does not keep alpha outside the particles.

labels.symptom: Scripts that call String.prototype.substr fail with 'TypeError: not a callable function'.
labels.root_cause: The embedded JavaScript engine has no String.prototype.substr.

labels.symptom: A large render started through the control channel stays at 'Rendering' with no progress and never writes the output file.
Choosing a track matte mode from the layer's dropdown does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Mode entries only take effect when a matte layer is already set; otherwise the click is silently dropped.

labels.symptom: A newly created text layer shows the placeholder 'Text' and typing doesn't change its content.
labels.root_cause: Creating a text layer doesn't enter text-editing mode, so keystrokes go to shortcuts or the layer rename.

labels.symptom: Timeline layers cannot be grouped into folders.
Effects cannot be driven by specific audio frequency bands.
Text layers cannot be converted into editable shape layers.
On Linux, especially Flatpak installs, fonts installed on the system don't show up in the font list.
labels.root_cause: Font discovery scans only a hard-coded list of directories and ignores the Flatpak host font paths, XDG data directories and fontconfig dir entries.

labels.symptom: In multi-view layouts, the Top, Front and Right panes don't draw camera or light wireframes.
labels.root_cause: The extra orthographic panes skip the camera and light wireframe drawing that the main view does.

labels.symptom: Context-menu actions on layers apply only to the right-clicked layer, not the whole selection.
labels.root_cause: Right-clicking re-selects just the clicked layer before running the menu command.

labels.symptom: GPU memory keeps growing during export until VRAM runs out and rendering falls back to the CPU.
labels.root_cause: GPU resources allocated for each rendered frame are never released.

labels.symptom: Scrubbing over keyframes with huge position values crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: The motion-path arc length overflows to NaN, which passes the guard and makes f64::clamp panic.

labels.symptom: Pressing Tab in a rename field leaves keyboard focus stuck, so Enter and shortcuts stop working.
labels.root_cause: egui's Tab focus traversal hands focus to another widget, and the panel's Enter handling only runs when no widget has focus.

labels.symptom: The viewer looks blurred at 100% zoom and above, so hard pixel edges look smeared.
labels.root_cause: The image rect isn't snapped to physical pixels and is drawn with bilinear magnification.

labels.symptom: Video the decoder can't read (e.g. H.264 10-bit 4:2:2) previews as black with no error shown.
labels.root_cause: Decode errors are only logged, once per frame, and the frame comes back empty without any message to the user.

labels.symptom: At 29.97 or 59.94 fps, entering a timecode in the current-time field moves the playhead to a different frame.
labels.root_cause: Parsing a timecode back into a frame doesn't use the same drop-frame mapping as the display.

labels.symptom: Several UI strings are not translated, the effects panel disappears when a layer is clicked, and creating a composition from an audio file fails.
GPU export runs out of memory and silently falls back to the CPU, making it slower than a CPU export.
labels.root_cause: Export submits a whole parallel batch of up to 16 frames to the GPU at once and does not log CPU fallbacks.

labels.symptom: Choosing a gradient fill for a shape layer shows no gradient editor and the shape stays a solid color.
Scripts that call keyInSpatialTangent or keyOutSpatialTangent fail with 'not a callable function'.
labels.root_cause: The getters were registered under the wrong names.

labels.symptom: No native Windows ARM64 installer is offered.
labels.root_cause: The release pipeline built only x64 Windows binaries.

labels.symptom: License files and brand terms don't follow the shared licensing standard.
Font menus list only the bundled fonts, not the fonts installed on the system.
labels.root_cause: System font folders were scanned only when a document asked for a missing family.

labels.symptom: The README doesn't say native Windows ARM64 builds are available or what their limits are.
Code can use unwrap, expect, panic or unsafe without lint errors.
Choosing an entry from a popup menu near the bottom of the window does nothing and the menu just closes.
labels.root_cause: egui hit-tests a fixed Area at its requested position, not where it was moved to fit, so the press counts as outside the popup.

labels.symptom: The revolutions part of angle values can't be clicked, typed into or dragged.
labels.root_cause: The angle widget only made the degrees part interactive.

labels.symptom: Toggling a layer's Audio, Lock or Shy switch wipes the preview cache, and playback with audio skips frames.
labels.root_cause: Cache keys hashed non-pixel switches and the comp's address, and audio playback did not wait for frames.

labels.symptom: The repository includes megabytes of committed build output from a nested target directory.
labels.root_cause: .gitignore ignored only the root /target.

labels.symptom: When video memory runs out, rendering crashes and the affected frames never render again.
labels.root_cause: The wgpu device had no uncaptured-error handler so out-of-memory panicked, and the GPU budget was fixed regardless of available memory.

labels.symptom: Quitting, closing the window or opening another project throws away unsaved changes without asking, and the title never shows a modified mark.
labels.root_cause: No unsaved-changes prompt existed, and the dirty state used revision numbers that only increased, so undoing back to the saved state did not clear it.

labels.symptom: Clicks and drags sent through automation with Shift or other modifiers act as plain clicks.
labels.root_cause: egui reads modifiers from Event::ModifiersChanged rather than from pointer events, so synthetic gestures never carried the modifiers.

labels.symptom: Items dragged into the timeline always land above the selected layer at the default time regardless of drop position.
labels.root_cause: Timeline drop ignored the pointer position for stack index and in point.

labels.symptom: Japanese text shows missing glyphs because no Japanese fonts are bundled.
labels.root_cause: No CJK fonts were embedded at build time.

labels.symptom: Dragging project items, files or effects onto the composition viewer does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The viewer panel did not accept drag-and-drop payloads from other panels.

labels.symptom: The project docs do not reflect recent fixes for user-reported bugs.
Entering a colour value that contains non-ASCII characters causes an internal error.
labels.root_cause: Byte slicing of the hex string split a multibyte character.

labels.symptom: The app crashes when GPU setup fails or the graphics device is lost.
labels.root_cause: Pipeline creation and device errors weren't contained in error scopes, so they panicked.

labels.symptom: Exporting with a broken precomp reference, or importing deeply nested XML, crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: expect() on the comp lookup, and recursive XML parsing with no depth limit.

labels.symptom: Pressing Escape in a numeric field doesn't cancel the edit, and values like 'inf' are accepted.
labels.root_cause: The numeric edit widget had no Escape cancel path and clamped values without first rejecting non-finite ones.

labels.symptom: Opening a project whose layer parent chains form a loop hangs the app.
labels.root_cause: Walking a layer's parents didn't detect cycles.

labels.symptom: The app crashes when GPU setup fails or the graphics device is lost.
labels.root_cause: Pipeline creation and device errors weren't contained in error scopes, so they panicked.

labels.symptom: Docs-only update recording recent fixes.
The README has no star history chart.
Importing a slightly malformed or deeply nested SVG hangs, uses all memory or crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: A number after Z looped forever in path parsing, and roxmltree recursion had no depth limit.
fixed_markers: elements nested more than 256 levels deep

labels.symptom: While the control port is open, a web page can send a cross-origin request to localhost and run commands.
labels.root_cause: The control server kept reading the connection after a line that was not a valid JSON request.

labels.symptom: Importing some malformed PDF or EPS files crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: close_path was called on empty paths, and from_str_radix was called with radix 0 or 1.

labels.symptom: Importing layered footage could crash the app on an unexpected state.
labels.root_cause: expect() was used on a second lookup of the same layer.

labels.symptom: The release guide is missing, the MCP tools table is incomplete, and the font-list test fails when extra JetBrains fonts are installed.
labels.root_cause: The guide was never written, the docs drifted from the code, and the test assumed exactly one matching font family.

labels.symptom: Rendering from the CLI with HEVC or AV1 format writes H.264, and an unknown composition name is reported as 'no active composition'.
labels.root_cause: The output path's extension overrode the explicit format, and comp lookup errors were collapsed to None.

labels.symptom: Opening a malformed PSD file crashes the app or runs out of memory.
labels.root_cause: Layer bounds overflowed i32, allocations were sized from the file without a cap, and the descriptor nesting limit reset at every level.

labels.symptom: Timeline property reveal shortcuts close other layers, zoom cannot fit the whole comp, and navigator handles cannot be dragged.
labels.root_cause: A single reveal filter was shared by the whole Timeline, and the zoom limit came from the current zoom.

labels.symptom: Project panel arrows and label swatches ignore clicks, new layers do not take their item's label colour, tracking ignores text alignment, and Delete removes the whole layer.
labels.root_cause: The row's click area was registered after its child widgets, so it covered them in hit-testing; other parts of the code ignored item labels and paragraph alignment.

labels.symptom: The anchor point tool does not snap to its own layer or honour modifier keys, and a locked viewer still switches to another composition.
labels.root_cause: Snapping excluded all of the dragged layer's targets, and the active viewer recorded the active comp before the lock was checked.

labels.symptom: The web hosting guide gives wrong caching, size and storage advice, so returning visitors keep an old release after an upgrade, and the Linux packages describe the wrong kind of app.
labels.root_cause: The hosting docs and package metadata were copied from another app and never updated, including immutable caching on file names that are not hashed.

labels.symptom: VP9 WebM exports report success but external decoders reject some frames.
labels.root_cause: Frames whose last byte matched the VP9 superframe marker pattern were misread as superframes by decoders.

labels.symptom: Preview audio goes silent about 12½ minutes into long audio or video files.
labels.root_cause: Conformed audio chunk times were computed as frame × ticks / rate in i64, which overflowed on long files.

labels.symptom: Clicking an editable value field puts the caret at the end instead of selecting the value, and stacked side panels cannot be resized by dragging between them.
labels.root_cause: Inline edit fields did not select all text on focus and re-requested focus before checking lost_focus; the dock stack had no draggable gutters.

labels.symptom: The command-line tool panics with a broken pipe when its output is piped to a reader that closes early, and unknown options are silently ignored.
labels.root_cause: CLI output used print macros that panic on stdout errors, and options were not validated.

labels.symptom: Release with a version bump.
Motion tracking could crash the app if a property group lookup failed.
labels.root_cause: expect() was used on re-looking up a group that had just been inserted.

labels.symptom: A saved custom workspace never shows up in the Window > Workspace menu, and the last entries of long submenus are cut off.
labels.root_cause: The workspace submenu was a fixed list, and egui submenus were capped at the default 400 pt scroll height.

labels.symptom: Clicking the export output path opens an inline name-template editor instead of a save dialog for picking the location.
labels.root_cause: Clicking the output name opened the template editor, and Choose File used the project save dialog with the project filter.

labels.symptom: After many evaluations, expressions fail with a maximum stack size error, and Delete with a pin selected deletes the whole layer.
labels.root_cause: The boa JS engine leaves values on its VM stack when an exception unwinds, so long-lived contexts slowly fill up.

labels.symptom: Layer Settings did nothing, and several project operations were missing.
Text scaled up via layer transform looks blurry.
labels.root_cause: Text was rasterised at font size and resampled by layer scale unless continuous rasterisation was enabled.

labels.symptom: Sibling-app references still use the old name PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
A deeply nested or very long expression crashes the whole app with a stack overflow.
labels.root_cause: The Boa parser and the expression rewriter recurse once per nesting level with no depth limit.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking empty space in the project or timeline panel does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Panel background responses had no context-menu handler.

labels.symptom: Grouped toolbar flyouts can be opened with a long press, not only by right-click.
The interface has no Brazilian Portuguese translation.
Audio spectrum and waveform effects stay frozen in the preview but animate correctly on export.
labels.root_cause: The layer cache treated audio visualiser effects as static because they were missing from TIME_DEPENDENT.

labels.symptom: Export could crash inside the AV1 encoder.
labels.root_cause: expect and unreachable were used on encoder invariants.

labels.symptom: On older GPUs the window never opens and the app exits silently at startup.
labels.root_cause: eframe's default asks for wgpu's default device limits, which older adapters can't meet, so the device request fails before any app code runs.

labels.symptom: Shape layers have no Add menu, and long popup menus are cut off so the bottom entries can't be reached.
labels.root_cause: egui lays out a popup at the previous frame's size, so the menu was capped too short.

labels.symptom: Dragging puppet pins lags badly.
labels.root_cause: The cache key for an effect's input hashed every effect on the layer, so each pin move invalidated the input and forced a full re-render.

labels.symptom: The gaps document does not list the recent user reports and their fixes.
In the browser build, replaced files are not picked up, failed worker starts hang jobs, and failed storage writes lose changes after reload.
labels.root_cause: Workers tracked files by length or path instead of version, async init rejections were swallowed, and failed storage writes were dropped.

labels.symptom: The About window doesn't credit contributors or models.
Export could crash inside the HEVC encoder.
labels.root_cause: expect, unwrap and unreachable were used on encoder invariants.

labels.symptom: A variable-font animation test fails on some installed fonts even though axis animation works.
labels.root_cause: The test animated the first listed axis instead of the nonconstant one and always applied a positive delta.

labels.symptom: Distortion effects on shape layers move only the bottom-right quadrant.
labels.root_cause: Edge-pinning bounds started at the layer origin instead of being centred on it.

labels.symptom: Shape layer size cannot be scaled with proportions locked, and new text and shape layers look pixelated when scaled up.
In the browser the canvas goes blank on small windows, unreadable picked files are silently ignored, and a lost graphics device freezes the view without notice.
labels.root_cause: A scroll-thumb clamp panicked when the track was shorter than its minimum, file reads failed all at once, and the device-lost notice was drawn on the dead canvas.

labels.symptom: Spacebar hand tool, the Effect Controls context menu, and drops on New Composition and timeline switches do not behave as expected.
Clicking a selected layer that sits behind other layers in the canvas selects the topmost layer instead.
labels.root_cause: The hit test always picked the topmost layer and ignored the current selection.

labels.symptom: Export could crash inside the Opus or VP9 encoder.
labels.root_cause: expect() was used on internal encoder state.

labels.symptom: Drawing, copying, pasting or duplicating while a shape layer's contents are selected acts on whole layers instead of the selected contents.
labels.root_cause: Shape tools and the clipboard had no handling for items inside a shape layer's contents.

labels.symptom: The interface language does not follow the operating system language.
labels.root_cause: No setting existed to detect and use the OS language.

labels.symptom: Documentation of the user reports and their fixes.
Running with RUST_LOG set prints nothing, so startup failures cannot be diagnosed.
labels.root_cause: The custom logger ignored RUST_LOG and wrote to a file only after logging was enabled in the Help menu.

labels.symptom: A golden-hash rendering test fails on macOS 27 even though the rendered frames are unchanged.
labels.root_cause: Exact f32 hashes depend on the platform libm, which changed in macOS 27.

labels.symptom: On some Intel integrated GPUs the app appears for a second and then quits with no message.
labels.root_cause: The graphics driver crashes with an access violation while the DirectX 12 or Vulkan device is created, and there was no automatic switch to OpenGL.

labels.symptom: Native project files from the commercial app can't be opened.
Importing a Lottie file with huge negative enum values crashes the app or gives wrong values.
labels.root_cause: Converting 1-based enums with n - 1 overflowed at i64::MIN.

labels.symptom: After Effects project files cannot be opened.
Selecting keyframes in the timeline shows nothing in the graph editor until the property is selected separately.
labels.root_cause: keys.select selected only the keys, not their properties and layers.

labels.symptom: Documents installing on Gentoo from a community overlay.
Motion tracking or camera solving could crash on difficult footage.
labels.root_cause: expect was used on tracker data that comes from the footage.

labels.symptom: Scale handles and the work area do not snap, and there are no snapping options.
Documents common pitfalls for agents driving the app over MCP.
There were no saved ease presets to apply to keyframe pairs.
Running a deeply nested script from the console or automation crashes the whole app with a stack overflow.
labels.root_cause: The Boa parser recurses per nesting level and scripts run inline on the caller's thread with no depth limit.

labels.symptom: Automation reports that GPU acceleration is on while rendering on the CPU, without saying why.
labels.root_cause: The GPU adapter error was only logged and never reported, and the headless --gpu flag was undocumented.

labels.symptom: Long dropdown menus are cut off at the screen edge, panels have no draggable scroll bars, and the first window runs under the taskbar.
labels.root_cause: Top-level menus had no scroll area, scroll bars only showed on hover, and the default window size ignored the taskbar.

labels.symptom: Soft Linear fractal noise shows a visible square grid.
labels.root_cause: The quintic fade has zero slope on lattice lines, which creases the contours.

labels.symptom: A bug in any single action closes the whole app and the user loses unsaved work.
labels.root_cause: Nothing caught panics in command execution, and panics were not logged.

labels.symptom: Unsaved work is lost when the headless MCP server is restarted by its client.
labels.root_cause: The headless MCP server kept the project only in memory and had no autosave.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window without a branded background or icon layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG packaging had no background image or Finder layout settings.

labels.symptom: Importing files freezes the app with no progress indication, and some animation keyframes are not shown in the timeline.
labels.root_cause: Imported files were probed on the UI thread, and revealed effect properties were a snapshot shown as flat rows.

labels.symptom: Launching the app twice quickly can switch window graphics to OpenGL for good, after which the app never starts.
labels.root_cause: The launch guard mistook another copy's launch-pending marker for a crash and switched to OpenGL, with nothing to switch back.

labels.symptom: An imported 3D model is invisible in a new composition.
labels.root_cause: Only the Advanced 3D renderer draws models, and new comps defaulted to Classic 3D.

labels.symptom: No FreeBSD or Flatpak release builds are published and AppImages cannot update themselves.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow lacked FreeBSD and Flatpak jobs and AppImages had no embedded zsync update info.

labels.symptom: Effect points on shape and text layers default to the bottom-right corner instead of the layer centre.
labels.root_cause: Effects measured positions from the layer origin rather than from the top-left of the effect bounds.

labels.symptom: Laying out empty text or failing to resolve a font could crash the app.
labels.root_cause: expect and index access were used in text layout and font fallback.

labels.symptom: The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app first and lists macOS builds before Windows.
The browser build warns that a language-support function is never used.
labels.root_cause: The wasm build's Match System used a literal instead of calling supported().

labels.symptom: The help for the new-light command now lists the Environment light and how to set its source.
Importing a 3D model asks how to interpret its alpha.
labels.root_cause: The unlabeled-alpha check was applied to every footage type, not just images.

labels.symptom: Japanese punctuation in vertical text appears in the wrong place and orientation.
labels.root_cause: Vertical text used horizontal glyphs without the vert/vrt2 features or VORG/vmtx metrics.

labels.symptom: Reading a property group through automation gives a misleading 'no property' error.
labels.root_cause: Property commands only resolved leaf properties and did not recognise groups.

labels.symptom: After panning the view with the middle mouse button or the Hand tool, it snaps back to where the drag started.
labels.root_cause: egui reports no total drag on the release frame, so the pan was recomputed as the start position plus zero.

labels.symptom: Background jobs, some commands or menu building could crash the app on unexpected state.
labels.root_cause: Engine code used expect() after state checks and on parsed menu trees.

labels.symptom: Audio from footage at a different sample rate stutters and sounds slowed in preview and export.
labels.root_cause: The MP4 reader returned wrong samples when asked for audio at a rate other than the file's own.

labels.symptom: Adds Simplified and Traditional Chinese interface translations.
Content-aware fill or path operations could crash on edge cases.
labels.root_cause: expect, unwrap and unreachable were used in raster and path code.

labels.symptom: CJK text renders as nothing when font fallback picks an installed font that maps those characters to empty glyphs.
labels.root_cause: The coverage check counted any non-zero cmap entry as coverage, even when the glyph draws nothing.

labels.symptom: Chinese text is drawn with Japanese glyph forms when the system locale is not Chinese.
labels.root_cause: A single CJK fallback font was chosen from the LANG/LC_ALL environment instead of the interface language.

labels.symptom: The audio spectrum visualisation draws bars in the wrong positions and at the wrong heights.
labels.root_cause: It used logarithmic band spacing, a decibel amplitude scale and sparse sampling within each band.

labels.symptom: RAM preview caching is improved: cache keys and eviction, Auto resolution and idle caching.
A relative output path given to the command-line tool is resolved against the project folder instead of the current directory, so files land in the wrong place or a doubled path.
labels.root_cause: The CLI passed the relative --out path to the engine's output resolver, which joins relative paths to the project directory.

labels.symptom: Rare internal lookups in effects code could crash the app instead of failing gracefully.
labels.root_cause: Effect registry code used expect() on lookups that could fail.

labels.symptom: Extreme time values, huge timecodes or a zero frame rate in a file crash the app or give wrong times.
labels.root_cause: Tick and timecode arithmetic did not saturate and divided by frame rates without checking for zero.

labels.symptom: Adding the first puppet pin makes the layer jump and rotate.
labels.root_cause: The ARAP solve with a single fixed pin was under-constrained, so round-off turned into rotation.

labels.symptom: EXR exports clip colour values above 1.0.
labels.root_cause: The EXR writers clamped colour to 0..1.

labels.symptom: Switching away from the text tool leaves text editing active, so the text layer can't be moved.
labels.root_cause: Changing tools did not end the text edit session.

labels.symptom: A GPU validation error could crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The uncaptured-error handler and render code called panic.

labels.symptom: Simplified Chinese labels don't match the reference application's wording.
The focused panel's outline is partly hidden by the panel's contents.
labels.root_cause: The focus outline was painted before the panel body, which then drew over it.

labels.symptom: A 32-bit float AIFF export is silently written as 24-bit integer audio.
labels.root_cause: The AIFF writer mapped F32 to S24.

labels.symptom: The whole app quits when one background render job hits a bug.
labels.root_cause: Jobs on the rayon ThreadPool were spawned without a panic_handler, so a panicking job aborted the process.

labels.symptom: The MCP automation interface lacks core tools, resources, progress reporting and cancellation.
Code that panics could be added to crates that are currently panic-free.
labels.root_cause: Crate roots didn't deny the panic lints.

labels.symptom: Face detection hangs forever on a NaN or zero-area detection box.
labels.root_cause: weighted_nms put the top box into the remaining list when its IoU with itself was 0, so the loop never shrank.

labels.symptom: A tiny malicious TFLite model makes the process abort with a huge memory allocation, or run for minutes.
labels.root_cause: Model::read capped only tensor size and did not bound kernel scratch space or total work.

labels.symptom: Nested compositions ignore the Preserve frame rate and Preserve resolution options.
On macOS, exported or saved files get the project extension appended or a doubled extension, such as name.png.proj.
labels.root_cause: Non-project save dialogs reused the project save dialog, whose filter makes macOS append the project extension, and names were never corrected afterwards.

labels.symptom: Several timeline, keyframe, Graph Editor and scrubbing behaviours differ from the reference app, including scrubbing that renders every frame.
Requesting footage audio at a zero mix rate could crash.
labels.root_cause: The resampler divided by the requested rate without a zero check.

labels.symptom: Assorted timeline, Time Remap, mask and context menu tweaks are missing or wrong.
Image sequence import can't bring in a single frame, ranges or folders, and silently closes gaps in the numbering.
Multi-layer EXR files with only named layers fail to import, and the EXR channel extractor offers no layer or channel choice.
labels.root_cause: The image decoder requires an unnamed RGB layer, and text parameters had no controls.
bug_markers: image does not contain non-deep rgb channels

labels.symptom: Face landmarks are offset by about a pixel, and absurd frame sizes cause an overflow panic.
labels.root_cause: The crop used a different sampling convention from MediaPipe's ImageToTensor and multiplied frame dimensions unchecked.

labels.symptom: Turning on idle frame caching with some settings crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: clamp was called with min greater than max.

labels.symptom: The in-window menu bar can't be used with the keyboard, and shortcuts fire while a menu is open.
labels.root_cause: The egui menu bar had no keyboard navigation and did not block shortcuts while a menu was open.

labels.symptom: Panels, dialogs and tooltips stay in English when another interface language is chosen.
labels.root_cause: UI strings below the menu bar were hardcoded instead of going through a translation catalog.

labels.symptom: A variable-font test fails on machines whose first variable font is monospaced.
labels.root_cause: The test assumed the weight axis changes glyph advances, which isn't true for monospaced fonts.

labels.symptom: An inline rename field cannot be left with Enter or a click elsewhere, and it blocks keyboard shortcuts while open.
labels.root_cause: The text field called request_focus() every frame, so focus could never leave it.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app freezes for about a second every few seconds, and Ctrl+C/X/V do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The UI thread polled system memory through a blocking PowerShell call, and egui-winit Copy/Cut/Paste events were ignored by the shortcut dispatcher.

labels.symptom: All themes look the same, and some panels stay dark in the Light theme.
labels.root_cause: Custom panel surfaces used hard-coded dark colors instead of theme colors.

labels.symptom: No Ukrainian interface language is available.
Effect parameter rows are tall and their indentation is inconsistent.
Script panels that were open when the app quit do not reopen at launch, and ease presets are built into the core.
The GPU Posterize effect gives different colours from CPU rendering near band thresholds.
labels.root_cause: Floating-point rounding in the shader's quotient correction; fixed with an explicit FMA.

labels.symptom: Interpret Footage trims image sequence frames instead of offering a Start Timecode override.
Effects cannot read their own layer input, CC Composite uses the processed image, and selecting a parameter does not activate its controls.
labels.root_cause: Self-input reads were blocked and the original effect-stack input was not captured.

labels.symptom: There is no way to score rendered frames against reference frames.
Render Queue export is slow and GPU export gives different pixels from run to run.
labels.root_cause: Export jobs built their renderer without a layer cache and used the auto backend, which switched between CPU and GPU compositors per frame.

labels.symptom: Parameter rows show separator lines that the reference app doesn't have.
Timeline and viewer interactions such as resize cursors, pick whip and the time display toggle behave differently than users expect.
The live preview freezes during rapid property edits until the drag stops.
labels.root_cause: The viewer only accepted the exact cache key for the newest revision, ignoring completed earlier revisions.

labels.symptom: While dragging a shape tool the preview is only a thin rectangle, and dragging a layer doesn't move the picture live.
labels.root_cause: The drag preview drew a generic box, and every pointer move changed the content cache key while the render was still running.

labels.symptom: Text shows light seams where glyphs touch, and overlays show fringes on anti-aliased edges.
labels.root_cause: Each glyph was rasterised and composited on its own, and overlay coverage was folded into opacity.

labels.symptom: The interface is slower when shown in a translated language because each string is looked up by scanning the whole catalog every frame.
labels.root_cause: The translation lookup scanned the catalog linearly for every string, every frame.

labels.symptom: Dropping files onto the window does nothing visible, gives no hover feedback, and on native Wayland drops are ignored completely.
labels.root_cause: Drops used stale layout geometry and unusable paths were dropped silently; eframe/winit 0.30 sends no file drop events on Wayland.

labels.symptom: Layered Blender EXR files show a Cryptomatte pass instead of the beauty image, and colour management options are missing.
labels.root_cause: The EXR layer picker chose the first colour layer unless it had a known beauty name.

labels.symptom: Parameterised graphics templates can't be rendered from the command line with a JSON file of values.
Timeline properties have no pick whip in the Parent & Link column.
A particle effect ignores the 3D camera and looks flat.
labels.root_cause: The particle effect projected through a fixed camera and the layer cache key omitted camera and lights.

labels.symptom: The MCP automation server hangs instead of exiting when it can't write output and stdin is still open.
labels.root_cause: thread::scope waited for the stdin reader thread after a write failed.

labels.symptom: Typing Arabic or other non-Latin names fails because switching keyboard layout with Alt+Shift focuses the menu bar, and Arabic, Hebrew, Indic and Thai text shows as boxes.
labels.root_cause: A lone Alt release after Alt+Shift counted as a menu-bar Alt tap, and the UI fonts lacked fallbacks for Arabic, Hebrew, Indic and Thai scripts.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Spanish.
Missing media can't be relinked in bulk by scanning a folder for matching files.
The viewer resolution is global and isn't saved per composition in the project.
labels.root_cause: Resolution was stored in the viewer UI state, not on the composition.

labels.symptom: ProRes exports are tagged as BT.709 even though the pixels use sRGB encoding, so colors look wrong in other tools.
labels.root_cause: The ProRes encoder wrote the wrong transfer characteristic tag for sRGB output.

labels.symptom: With Japanese selected, only the menus are translated and panels, dialogs and tooltips stay in English.
labels.root_cause: The interface catalog had no Japanese table.

labels.symptom: A 3D layer jumps to a different position when you change its parent.
labels.root_cause: Position compensation didn't account for the parent's 3D transform.

labels.symptom: With Ukrainian selected, panels and dialogs stay in English and the platform-specific Reveal commands aren't recognised.
labels.root_cause: The interface catalog had no Ukrainian table and the Windows/Linux Reveal spellings were not mapped.

labels.symptom: The command-line bitrate option has no effect on VP9 WebM output.
labels.root_cause: The CLI set the bitrate but never turned on webmBitrate, so the encoder stayed in quality mode.

labels.symptom: A script that imports one numbered file brings in the whole image sequence.
labels.root_cause: The scripting prelude never passed the sequence flag to file.import.

labels.symptom: The keying effect's eyedropper samples the already-keyed frame instead of the original footage.
labels.root_cause: The eyedropper read from the viewer's output instead of the effect's input.

labels.symptom: Add Expression always fails with a missing-path error even when a property is selected.
labels.root_cause: The command required an explicit path or property id and ignored the timeline selection.

labels.symptom: Multi-part EXR files from Blender 5 show channel names with the part name doubled, so pass and Cryptomatte lookups fail.
labels.root_cause: The EXR reader put the part name in front of channel names that already contained it.

labels.symptom: Opening a comp replaces the current Timeline instead of adding a tab, and dragging a tab gives no sign of where it will land.
After choosing a non-English language, some tooltips, option lists and formatted labels stay in English.
labels.root_cause: Helper-drawn text, data tables and strings built with format! before the lookup never reached the translation catalog.

labels.symptom: Frame boundaries at fractional frame rates are off, and very large timecode values overflow.
labels.root_cause: Frame-to-tick rounding and integer arithmetic did not handle fractional rates or saturate safely.

labels.symptom: The documentation no longer matches what the code actually does.
Collapsed precomps and animated shape or text content don't motion-blur.
Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: In the browser, playback with several stacked video clips is slow and the page eventually runs out of memory.
labels.root_cause: The wasm caches were too large and frames were converted to RGBA at full size before being scaled down.

labels.symptom: OpenFX image-effect plug-ins cannot be loaded.
The Home screen and the logo next to the Home button don't look like the original app, and a sibling-app link points to a repo that doesn't exist.
labels.root_cause: The sibling-app link pointed to the nonexistent DrawCraft repo.

labels.symptom: Closing the GPU Information dialog opened from Settings closes Settings too instead of returning to it.
labels.root_cause: Dismissing the info dialog didn't reopen its parent dialog.

labels.symptom: CI runs show Node 20 deprecation warnings from GitHub Actions.
labels.root_cause: The workflows used outdated action versions that run on Node 20.

labels.symptom: Users who installed a release package can't find the CLI path needed to register the MCP server.
labels.root_cause: The docs only covered source builds, the Windows MSI doesn't add the CLI to PATH, and on macOS the CLI isn't inside the .app.

labels.symptom: No RISC-V Linux packages are released.
The theme can't follow the system's light/dark setting and there are no separate light and dark theme choices.
Version bump to 0.2.0.
The command schema lists optional text-styling keys as required, so schema validators reject valid text edits.
labels.root_cause: Parameter doc strings lacked the '?' optional marker the schema generator expects.

labels.symptom: Property and keyframe commands ignore explicit layer or composition time bases.
Editing keyframe attributes reorders the selection or edits duplicate keys more than once.
labels.root_cause: Attribute edits did not preserve selection order or dedupe references.

labels.symptom: The Packaging lint CI workflow fails on the release workflow with shellcheck warning SC2015.
labels.root_cause: The Install wasm-bindgen CLI step used an `A && B || C` pattern, which shellcheck flags.

labels.symptom: Editing one composition threw away the cached preview frames of every other composition, and the disk cache could serve stale frames when proxies changed.
labels.root_cause: Preview frames were keyed by project revision, and the disk cache key ignored proxies and the Use Proxy setting.

labels.symptom: Users can open several composition viewers, each locked to its own composition.
Scripted solid creation ignores the requested pixel aspect ratio without reporting it.
labels.root_cause: The scripting wrapper did not forward pixelAspect to the underlying command.

labels.symptom: Exported audio is shifted when the work area starts at a nonzero time.
labels.root_cause: Audio sample positions were not preserved at nonzero export starts.

labels.symptom: Opening or importing a small crafted PDF makes the app request gigabytes of memory and crash.
labels.root_cause: PDF stream filter decoding had no output size limit, so chained compression could expand without bound.

labels.symptom: Script install, uninstall or run commands with a path-like name can delete or execute files outside the scripts folder.
labels.root_cause: Request-supplied script names were joined into paths without checking they were bare file names.

labels.symptom: Setting an item's selected flag to false in a script does not deselect it.
labels.root_cause: The scripting setter only handled true assignments.

labels.symptom: A precomp layer's bar in the timeline does not show the nested comp's markers.
Reading superscript or subscript right after setting it in a script returns the old value.
labels.root_cause: Pending baseline edits were not synced with the canonical baseline attribute.

labels.symptom: Expression text style getters report the old baseline after setting superscript or subscript.
labels.root_cause: Setters did not use the canonical baseline operation, leaving getters stale.

labels.symptom: Passing a project file in an alternate project format on the command line imports it as media instead of opening it.
labels.root_cause: The launch argument handler recognised only one project extension and compared extensions case-sensitively.

labels.symptom: Creating a text layer with an empty position array gives an internal index error instead of a clear argument error.
labels.root_cause: The position array was indexed directly without validation.

labels.symptom: Adding a render job with a built-in settings template fails with a missing output module template error.
labels.root_cause: The settings template name was also resolved as an output module template.

labels.symptom: Changing only output height with aspect lock on leaves the rendered size unchanged.
labels.root_cause: Height-only resize updates were not used to derive the width.

labels.symptom: Setting a property's selected flag to false in a script does not deselect it.
labels.root_cause: No engine command existed to deselect a single property.

labels.symptom: Animated GIFs import as a single still frame.
labels.root_cause: GIFs went through the still-image path in probing.

labels.symptom: Dragging the current-time indicator gives no audio feedback.
Some UI labels stay in English when the interface language is Chinese.
labels.root_cause: Hardcoded UI strings were not wrapped in translation calls.

labels.symptom: Closing an inactive tab switches the visible panel in a tab group.
labels.root_cause: Removing an earlier tab shifted the active index without adjustment.

labels.symptom: Opening a small crafted PDF crashes from huge allocations, stack overflow or a panic.
labels.root_cause: PDF colour space and function sizes, depth and references were trusted without bounds.

labels.symptom: Reloading footage keeps showing the old pixels, and Photoshop layer items lose their layer.
labels.root_cause: Reload did not clear the path-keyed frame caches and replaced the whole footage with a merged-document probe.

labels.symptom: Several tests fail on Windows because of escaped paths, the WARP GPU adapter, and an audio preview timing race.
labels.root_cause: Tests assumed unescaped paths, a working GPU compute adapter and slower timing.

labels.symptom: Roto Brush segmentation can't use a trained model.
On macOS, double-clicking a project file in Finder or using open -a launches the app without opening the document, and the bundle claims another app's file extension.
labels.root_cause: Info.plist exported the wrong extension and declared no document types, and winit 0.30 ignores the kAEOpenDocuments Apple event.

labels.symptom: Dragging a rotation or angle value cannot take it below zero; the value bounces back to positive.
labels.root_cause: The drag was applied to the unsigned remainder and then the old sign was put back on.

labels.symptom: Reset in Effect Controls does nothing for parameters inside twirl-down groups.
labels.root_cause: Reset looked up grouped parameter ids as plain child names, found nothing and skipped them.

labels.symptom: On Windows with AMD GPUs the app crashes on every launch just as its window appears.
labels.root_cause: The AMD Vulkan driver crashes on swapchain re-creation when the hidden window is shown, and the launch guard cleared its marker at the first frame, so it never switched to OpenGL.

labels.symptom: Agent instructions do not point to the shared real-file test corpora.
Scrubbing a number field stops when the pointer reaches the edge of the screen.
Choosing a font means scrolling the whole family list with no way to search.
There is no text box effect with signed padding and an independent matte.
Undo history trimming throws away history branches you can still reach.
labels.root_cause: Orphaned branches used up the branch budget, so reachable branches were dropped.

labels.symptom: Batch landing of many community changes, including a path traversal fix in script install/run commands.
After about 100 evaluations, expressions fail with a maximum stack size error and silently fall back to their keyframed values.
labels.root_cause: In boa 0.22, exceptions thrown from nested calls leak the value stack.

labels.symptom: On FreeBSD the system info panel doesn't show memory, CPU model or OS version.
labels.root_cause: There was no FreeBSD code to collect system info.

labels.symptom: Editing the work area can leave it inverted, and trimming to it gives a negative composition duration.
labels.root_cause: Work-area edits were not clamped to stay inside the composition and at least one frame long.

labels.symptom: After resizing or cropping the composition frame, layers with separated Position dimensions stay at their old coordinates.
labels.root_cause: Resize and crop commands offset only the combined Position property, not the separated X/Y Position channels and keys.

labels.symptom: Editing Position reports success but a layer with separated dimensions does not move.
labels.root_cause: The Position command wrote only the combined property while the renderer reads the separated X/Y/Z channels.

labels.symptom: An opaque layer disappears when its first mask uses Intersect or Darken mode.
labels.root_cause: The first Intersect/Darken mask was combined with empty coverage instead of full coverage.

labels.symptom: Face tracking can use a downloadable trained model.
Committing the displayed current time moves the playhead to a different frame.
labels.root_cause: Timecode and frame entries were parsed without the start timecode or frame numbering offset.

labels.symptom: On Linux, audio playback starts late while the video starts at once.
labels.root_cause: The PulseAudio/PipeWire stream opened with a large default buffer and played silence until samples were queued.

labels.symptom: Korean (Hangul) text in the interface shows as boxes on macOS.
labels.root_cause: The font fallback setup probed only kana and Han characters, so no face covering Hangul was registered.

labels.symptom: The progress and parity docs are out of date.
Extra (passive) viewers show colours without the monitor colour conversion.
labels.root_cause: Passive viewers uploaded frames without applying the display colour conversion.

labels.symptom: The locked viewer keeps old colours after the display profile or output simulation changes.
labels.root_cause: The texture cache key did not include the display conversion inputs.

labels.symptom: Release version bump.
The CC Power Pin Unstretch checkbox has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The effect never read the Unstretch control.

labels.symptom: Wire removal set to Frame Offset gives the same result as Displace.
labels.root_cause: The Frame Offset style ran the Displace code and ignored the offset slider.

labels.symptom: Rove Across Time can put a key on the same time as a fixed key, and a later nudge deletes one of them.
labels.root_cause: Retiming roving keys for zero-length segments gave a key exactly the endpoint's time.

labels.symptom: Converting an expression to keyframes on a time-reversed layer freezes the animation.
labels.root_cause: The baked keys were stored in descending time order and never sorted.

labels.symptom: Recording a keyboard shortcut also types the key into the field, and shortcuts using the plus key never fire.
labels.root_cause: Key and text events reached the focused text field while recording, and the shortcut parser split 'Cmd++' into an empty key name.

labels.symptom: On macOS, exporting or rendering an unsaved document with no output folder set fails because it tries to write to the root folder.
labels.root_cause: Relative output paths fell back to the process working directory, which is / for apps launched from the Finder.

labels.symptom: Wheel zoom and pan stop working in the viewer while a tracking point overlay is shown.
labels.root_cause: A full-area click_and_drag overlay widget took the hover and drag from the viewer.

labels.symptom: After closing every panel, picking a panel from the Window menu does not put it back into the empty dock.
labels.root_cause: The dock's open-near logic did nothing when no anchor panel was docked and had no fallback for an empty dock.

labels.symptom: Automation clients can't find out the valid values, ranges or choices for effect parameters.
labels.root_cause: The effect list command left out parameter types, popup choices and slider bounds.

labels.symptom: Dragging several selected project items onto the timeline adds only one of them.
labels.root_cause: The drag payload carried only the one item that started the drag.

labels.symptom: Gradient editing controls are shown but clicking them does nothing, so gradients cannot be edited.
labels.root_cause: The UI panels showed gradient values but had no editor wired to them.

labels.symptom: Colour pickers have no hex field, and some dialogs save picked colours darker than what was chosen.
labels.root_cause: sRGB values were passed to egui's color_edit_button_rgb, which treats them as linear.

labels.symptom: Batch merge of community fixes, including a crash when editing a project with an inverted work area and agent drags moving the real cursor.
labels.root_cause: Batch merge; includes clamp with crossed bounds panicking on inverted work areas.

labels.symptom: GPU export of nested compositions is very slow while the GPU sits idle.
labels.root_cause: Precomp layers were rendered on the CPU and uploaded to the GPU every frame.

labels.symptom: A batch of community fixes and features was merged.
Dragging a panel divider past its minimum size crashes the app, and scripts can grant themselves file and network access.
labels.root_cause: The dock split called clamp with crossed bounds, and scripts were allowed to change scripting permission prefs.

labels.symptom: The clippy CI step fails on Rust 1.95 with collapsible_match errors.
labels.root_cause: A newer clippy flags an if nested inside a match arm that could be a guard.

labels.symptom: GPU export of nested compositions is very slow while the GPU sits idle.
labels.root_cause: Precomp layers were rendered on the CPU and uploaded to the GPU every frame.

labels.symptom: Auto-Bezier motion paths take a different shape from the reference app's.
labels.root_cause: Spatial tangents were scaled by segment length, and end keys got no tangent, instead of using Catmull-Rom (next − previous)/6.

labels.symptom: Editing several selected layers changes only one, stacked panels can't hold tabs, and 32 bpc blend modes don't match the reference app.
labels.root_cause: Several separate bugs in property editing, dock layout and blend math.

labels.symptom: Ctrl/Cmd plus and minus do not zoom the main viewer.
labels.root_cause: The default shortcut table has no Ctrl/Cmd plus and minus bindings for zoom.

labels.symptom: Dropping footage on an empty timeline does nothing instead of creating a composition.
labels.root_cause: The timeline returned early without a drop target when there was no active composition.

labels.symptom: Fonts in a custom folder can't be used unless they are installed system-wide.
labels.root_cause: Font discovery only scanned the system font folders.

labels.symptom: German is not available as an interface language.
The light theme shows dark-on-dark panels, Sync with System stops following the macOS appearance, and one failing GPU kernel on DX12 disables the whole GPU renderer.
labels.root_cause: Hardcoded colours instead of theme tokens, visuals set only on one egui style, and a single kernel build failure disabling the GPU path.

labels.symptom: Batch of community changes: font folders, empty-timeline drop, tangents, lint.
No Linux riscv64 release download is available.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow had no riscv64 job.

labels.symptom: UI tests panic in debug builds with 'Dropped TexturesDelta with 1 unapplied deltas'.
labels.root_cause: The test harness threw away egui's FullOutput without clearing textures_delta.

labels.symptom: On some GPUs such as Adreno, the app crashes on buffer allocation failure or when the graphics device is lost.
labels.root_cause: Buffers were created mapped at creation without error scopes, and device loss panicked inside egui-wgpu.

labels.symptom: When the graphics device is lost, the window closes without telling the user why or where the recovery copy is.
labels.root_cause: Nothing showed the user a message when the GPU device was lost.

labels.symptom: Dragging a layer piles up frame renders until memory runs out, and footage saved with relative paths goes missing.
labels.root_cause: A pool thread waiting inside a render ran newer frame spawns nested on top of it, and relative footage paths were not resolved next to the project file.

labels.symptom: An imported animated GIF does not play in preview or export.
labels.root_cause: The GIF was probed as a still image.

labels.symptom: Effects on text and shape layers are clipped at the content's bounding box.
labels.root_cause: The effect input buffer covered only the painted pixels, not the whole layer region.

labels.symptom: GPU export of effect-heavy compositions is very slow.
labels.root_cause: Effect stacks round-trip through the CPU, intermediates allocate new textures, and footprint keys change every frame.

labels.symptom: Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
On systems without Vulkan, GPU rendering on the OpenGL backend fails or silently draws nothing.
labels.root_cause: Render targets such as R32Float can't be rendered to on GLES, and the GL backend has a single adapter context lock that times out.

labels.symptom: The Edit Gradient control on gradient properties does nothing when clicked.
labels.root_cause: The control only painted its label and had no gradient editor behind it.

labels.symptom: Pixel Motion Blur shows doubled copies of moving content and Vector Detail does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The effect averaged fetched frames instead of synthesizing in-betweens from motion vectors.

labels.symptom: A host page that embeds the web app cannot open files in it or receive saved files; saves become browser downloads.
The GPU information dialog never names the graphics card, so it looks like the GPU was not detected.
labels.root_cause: The dialog showed fixed text instead of the detected adapter or the reason GPU compositing is off.

labels.symptom: Setting a composition frame rate to zero crashes the app, and negative rates are accepted.
labels.root_cause: The frame rate was passed to FrameRate::from_f64 without validation, which led to a divide by zero.

labels.symptom: Clicking in the viewer selects hidden or non-soloed layers.
labels.root_cause: Viewer hit-testing ignored layer visibility and solo state.

labels.symptom: A time-varying effect on an adjustment layer makes every frame re-render and re-upload a full-frame buffer.
labels.root_cause: The adjustment footprint's cache key hashed the whole effect stack, so it changed every frame.

labels.symptom: The Brightness & Contrast effect gives much stronger contrast than the reference app.
labels.root_cause: The contrast curve g = 2^(2c) is far too steep.

labels.symptom: Tests fail on Windows when the repo and the home folder are on different drives.
labels.root_cause: Tests use drive-less /tmp paths and compare them with std::path::absolute, which takes the working directory's drive.

labels.symptom: UI scale can only be set to a few preset percentages, with nothing between 75% and 100%.
labels.root_cause: The UI scale setting was a fixed choice list, and number fields applied partly typed values.
