labels.symptom: Dropping footage onto an empty viewer does not create a composition.
labels.root_cause: The empty viewer's rendering path returns before the drag-and-drop handler runs.

labels.symptom: There is no lasting setting to show the menus in Japanese.
The cylinder effect has only one rotation control, with no separate X, Y and Z rotation.
labels.root_cause: The cylinder was assumed to be aligned with the vertical axis.

labels.symptom: Long renders stall partway through and the computer slows down until the app is closed.
labels.root_cause: GPU readback staging buffers piled up without limit when frame sizes changed every frame.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: Pressing Delete or Backspace in a focused panel doesn't delete the selected items there and can delete something else instead.
labels.root_cause: The Delete shortcut was sent to the timeline whichever panel had focus.

labels.symptom: Video export encoding uses only one CPU core.
labels.root_cause: The AV1, VP9 and HEVC encoders ran serially.

labels.symptom: Blurs, colour conversion and layer blending are slow when rendering frames.
labels.root_cause: Per-pixel work was repeated, such as per-channel transfer curve evaluation and per-pixel blend mode matching.

labels.symptom: The app icon uses the old animal artwork instead of the letter monogram.
A contributor's real name is missing from the About Contributors list.
Clicking links such as Discord buttons or Help links does nothing in the desktop app.
labels.root_cause: eframe's links feature was not enabled, so open_url did nothing on native builds.

labels.symptom: The timeline ruler shows seconds:frames labels even when time display is set to Frames.
labels.root_cause: The ruler label format was hard-coded and ignored the project setting.

labels.symptom: Cryptomatte selection names that contain commas give an empty matte.
labels.root_cause: The selection was split on every comma before quotes were handled.

labels.symptom: Dropping a PSD file on the window imports it at once without showing the import options dialog.
labels.root_cause: The drop handler always passed importAs, which skips the dialog.

labels.symptom: STL 3D model files cannot be imported.
There is no way to copy the current frame to the system clipboard.
Pasting SVG markup from the system clipboard does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Paste only read the app's internal clipboard.

labels.symptom: Scaling a layer by its handles doesn't follow the pointer and can collapse to zero.
labels.root_cause: Incremental per-frame rescaling accumulated error, and hit-testing used the post-threshold drag point.

labels.symptom: Mesh Warp shows no grid in the viewer, so nothing can be dragged to warp the layer.
labels.root_cause: The viewer only drew handles for point parameters, and the mesh is stored as a hidden text parameter.

labels.symptom: FBX 3D models cannot be imported.
Holding Shift while dragging a Bezier handle in the graph editor does not lock it to one axis.
labels.root_cause: Only keyframe drags applied the Shift axis constraint; handle drags ignored it.

labels.symptom: The toolbar fill and stroke options cannot change or remove the fill or outline of selected shapes.
labels.root_cause: shape.fillStroke had no fill or stroke kind parameter.

labels.symptom: Decoding multi-layer EXR files uses about twice as much memory as needed.
labels.root_cause: The whole decoded image was kept alive and every channel was copied through an extra Vec while the planes were built.

labels.symptom: Linear float footage ignores the Working Gamma setting and can be gamma-encoded twice.
labels.root_cause: Float footage is sRGB-encoded at decode time before the project's curve is known.

labels.symptom: Extruded 3D shapes and text cannot have separate front, bevel, side and back colours.
Importing Targa or Radiance HDR files fails even though the media browser lists them.
labels.root_cause: The importable extension list and still decoder lacked tga and hdr.

labels.symptom: Two 3D reference compasses are drawn in the viewer.
labels.root_cause: Two separate implementations of the reference axes both drew.

labels.symptom: The font menu cannot be filtered to show only variable fonts.
labels.root_cause: Font scan does not record whether a face has an fvar table.

labels.symptom: Scripts that call a layer or property as a function fail with 'not a callable function'.
labels.root_cause: Layer and property objects were Proxies around plain objects, which cannot be called.

labels.symptom: Effects & Presets has no Transitions category of animation presets.
labels.root_cause: Only a few text-animator presets were bundled.

labels.symptom: DPX and Cineon images and image sequences cannot be imported.
labels.root_cause: No decoder existed for DPX or Cineon files.

labels.symptom: An animated WebP imports as a still and shows only its first frame.
labels.root_cause: The probe sent every WebP down the still-image path.

labels.symptom: MXF footage cannot be imported even though the media browser lists it.
labels.root_cause: The mxf extension was missing from the importable video extensions and dialog filters.

labels.symptom: The viewer updates slowly while dragging a layer, though playback is fast.
labels.root_cause: Paused RAM-preview prefetch rendered stale frames during edits, blocking the needed viewer frame.

labels.symptom: Scripts that use #include directives fail to parse.
labels.root_cause: ExtendScript preprocessor directives were not handled.

labels.symptom: Scripts that call $.evalFile or check BridgeTalk fail during initialisation.
labels.root_cause: $.evalFile always threw an error and BridgeTalk was undefined.

labels.symptom: Scrubbing a timeline value with several layers selected cannot spread the change proportionally across the layers.
Mouse event listeners on script UI controls never run.
labels.root_cause: The ScriptUI host did not send mouse events to script listeners.

labels.symptom: There is no way to render to a single uncompressed movie file.
Dragging a panel by its menu button highlights a dock target but drops nothing, and panels cannot be resized.
In a list panel the arrow keys don't move the selection, and screen readers announce the rows and buttons without names.
labels.root_cause: Custom-drawn panel widgets had no arrow-key handling and gave AccessKit no names or roles.

labels.symptom: Repeating scheduled script tasks never run.
labels.root_cause: The task loop skipped repeating tasks (`if repeat { continue; }`).

labels.symptom: With the Ukrainian language selected, many panels, tooltips and dialogs still show English text.
labels.root_cause: The Ukrainian UI catalog fell behind as new rows were added to the panel catalog.

labels.symptom: Scrubbing a long video updates the viewer only seconds after the pointer stops.
labels.root_cause: Superseded frame requests kept decoding on the shared decoder because no cooperative cancellation was used.

labels.symptom: Opening a project file with deeply nested XML crashes the app instead of showing an error.
labels.root_cause: The hand-written XML project reader recursed once per nested element with no depth limit, so it overflowed the stack.

labels.symptom: Panels cannot be moved out to a separate window on a second monitor.
labels.root_cause: Floating panels could only float inside the main window.

labels.symptom: Opening a corrupt or hostile project can trigger huge memory allocations or a crash.
labels.root_cause: Dimension and frame-rate limits were not enforced when loading a project file.

labels.symptom: Text in a narrow side panel runs past the panel's right edge with no padding.
labels.root_cause: Panel detail labels were painted without a width limit or truncation.

labels.symptom: The signed macOS app in the downloaded DMG fails code-signature validation.
labels.root_cause: Extended attributes added at build time and the DMG packaging step break the strict codesign check.

labels.symptom: There is no way to create a tracked object matte from a point or box prompt.
Preview playback stutters or freezes because frames just ahead of the playhead are dropped from the cache.
labels.root_cause: The cache evicted least-recently-used frames and prefetch ran in request order, so frames near the playhead were evicted and re-rendered last.

labels.symptom: Importing a long video uses as much memory as the file's size, or twice that during import.
labels.root_cause: Media probing and the media pool read the whole file into memory instead of streaming it.

labels.symptom: Footage dropped on the timeline is cut to the composition's length instead of keeping its full duration.
labels.root_cause: Adding an item clamped the layer's out point to the composition duration.

labels.symptom: Automation commands fail with 'no layer "98"' when a numeric id is sent as a string.
labels.root_cause: String references were resolved only as names, never as numeric ids.

labels.symptom: On Windows and Linux, Ctrl+F triggers both Find and Enter Full Screen.
labels.root_cause: The macOS-only Ctrl+Cmd+F shortcut collapses to Ctrl+F because Cmd maps to Ctrl off macOS.

labels.symptom: When run from an AppImage on Wayland, the window shows the generic Wayland icon instead of the app icon.
labels.root_cause: Wayland takes the icon from the desktop entry matching the window's app ID, and an AppImage installs no desktop entry.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
There is no in-app chat panel for local models or agents.
Some crafted or deeply nested expressions crash the app with a stack overflow or hang rendering.
labels.root_cause: The expression parser's nesting limit missed unbracketed chains, and self-referencing expressions could recurse without bound.

labels.symptom: Dragging layers in heavy compositions makes the UI stall and the selection box lag behind the mouse.
labels.root_cause: Expression diagnostics and timeline content hashing ran synchronously on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: Files cannot be imported by double-clicking the project panel's empty area, and files dragged onto the window are not imported on Wayland.
labels.root_cause: There was no double-click handler on the empty area, and winit does not deliver file drops on Wayland.

labels.symptom: The gaps document cites user issues that have since been fixed.
The active panel tab has an underline, and the tab strip gradient stops short of the panel edges.
labels.root_cause: The gradient was inset by the corner radius instead of following the rounded corners.

labels.symptom: The layer panel cannot be zoomed or panned, and View zoom ignores the focused viewer.
The empty panel's hint text runs past the edges and is clipped when the panel is narrow.
labels.root_cause: The hint was painted as one centred line with no wrap width.

labels.symptom: There is no way to star favorite themes and switch between them quickly.
Imported photos and phone videos appear sideways, ignoring their orientation.
labels.root_cause: The Exif orientation and the MP4 rotation were ignored.

labels.symptom: The window opens at a fixed size and position on every launch instead of where it was left.
labels.root_cause: The window geometry was never saved.

labels.symptom: Release-mode CI fails to compile a UI test.
labels.root_cause: egui Style.debug exists only under debug_assertions, so a test that sets it does not build in release mode.

labels.symptom: In Brazilian Portuguese, panel labels, buttons and tooltips stay in English.
labels.root_cause: There was no pt-BR panel translation catalog.

labels.symptom: On laptops without Page Up/Down keys there is no keyboard shortcut to step frames.
Arabic is not available as an interface language.
Japanese, Chinese or Korean text shows as missing-glyph boxes unless a CJK font is named explicitly, and PostScript font names are not recognised.
labels.root_cause: Font fallback only searched bundled and already-loaded faces, with no script-aware system font lookup, and resolution only matched family names.

labels.symptom: Scripts that read, write or copy binary files corrupt them by replacing bytes with U+FFFD.
labels.root_cause: The script file bridge always decodes and encodes contents as UTF-8, even in BINARY mode.

labels.symptom: Running command 16 from a script runs an unrelated command instead of Undo.
labels.root_cause: Numeric command IDs are positions in the internal registry, not stable identifiers.

labels.symptom: A script undo group with more edits than the undo limit can't be undone in one step.
labels.root_cause: History trimming removed the group's opening snapshot, so the group could not be collapsed.

labels.symptom: Deleting many keyframes from a script is slow.
labels.root_cause: Each removeKey call dispatches a separate engine edit.

labels.symptom: Setting a layer comment from a script does nothing, and marker parameters are lost when the marker has no cue point name.
labels.root_cause: Layer.comment has no setter, and the marker cue point is only written when it has a name.

labels.symptom: Scripts can't use direct layer transform shortcuts such as layer.position.
labels.root_cause: The AVLayer prelude doesn't define the transform shortcut properties.

labels.symptom: A panel tab's lock icon shows a closed padlock even when the tab is unlocked.
labels.root_cause: The same closed padlock icon was drawn in both states; only the brightness changed.

labels.symptom: Scripts that call String.substr fail with 'not a callable function'.
labels.root_cause: The script runtime has no String.prototype.substr.

labels.symptom: A layered PSD imported from a script comes in as one flattened image.
labels.root_cause: The script import function ignored ImportOptions.importAs.

labels.symptom: In scripts, comparing the same layer or project item with === returns false.
labels.root_cause: Every access built a new wrapper object instead of reusing a cached one.

labels.symptom: Scripts that look up text path options by standard match name get null.
labels.root_cause: Internal property ids were exposed instead of the standard match names.

labels.symptom: The Layer panel always shows the layer fitted to the panel and cannot be zoomed or panned.
Clicking in the thin gap between two menu entries does nothing and neither entry highlights.
labels.root_cause: The global egui item spacing left vertical gaps between menu rows.

labels.symptom: Some malformed imported files crash the app or make it hang, for example a PDF whose page tree refers to itself.
labels.root_cause: Parsers had no visit budget for cyclic page trees, and huge path coordinates were not clamped before rasterising.

labels.symptom: Effects, caches, export and playback are slow.
The U and UU reveal shortcuts never show Time Remap on a layer that has time remapping enabled.
labels.root_cause: The reveal command only walked the layer's top-level property groups and skipped properties at the root of the tree.

labels.symptom: Figma import, effect search, relinking moved footage and AZERTY shortcuts are missing.
AI agents cannot fully drive or check the app headlessly through MCP, and the control channel is fragile.
Native project files from the original application cannot be imported.
Window menu entries have no check marks showing which panels are visible.
There is no way to edit a shape's gradient start and end points by dragging them in the viewer.
A reopened project always opens on its first composition instead of the one that was active when it was saved.
labels.root_cause: The project file did not store the active or open compositions.

labels.symptom: The ▸ separator in menu paths and hints shows as an empty box instead of an arrow.
labels.root_cause: Neither Inter nor egui's default fallback fonts have a glyph for U+25B8, and no bundled font with it was added as a fallback.

labels.symptom: Reveal All Modified Properties misses changed options and layer styles, and wrongly shows camera and light positions as modified.
labels.root_cause: The modified-property reveal compared only against 2D Transform defaults and not against a fresh layer of the same kind.

labels.symptom: After Layer > New > Text, typed text renames the layer instead of going into the text.
labels.root_cause: The menu created the text layer without starting an edit session.

labels.symptom: Picking a track matte mode on a layer that has no matte does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The menu only sent the command when a matte layer was already set.

labels.symptom: Menus can't be shown in Russian, French or German.
On Linux, especially in Flatpak, fonts installed on the system are missing from the font list.
labels.root_cause: Only four hardcoded font folders were scanned; the Flatpak host, XDG and fontconfig folders were not.

labels.symptom: Extra 3D layout views draw no camera or light wireframes, so moving the camera shows nothing there.
labels.root_cause: draw_rigs was only called for the main view, so the extra panes never drew the wireframes.

labels.symptom: Scrubbing the timeline over spatial keyframes with huge values crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: Motion-path arc length overflows to NaN and clamp panics on the NaN bound.

labels.symptom: Pressing Tab in a rename field moves keyboard focus away, and Enter no longer renames items.
labels.root_cause: egui's single-line TextEdit doesn't claim Tab, so Tab moves focus to the next widget and blocks the panel's keyboard shortcuts.

labels.symptom: Previews and the disk cache use too much RAM and disk space.
labels.root_cause: Preview renders, frame retention and cache writes had no limits, and the default disk cache was 100 GB.

labels.symptom: Video footage the built-in decoders can't read shows a black picture with no explanation.
labels.root_cause: Decode failures were only logged per frame and the reason was never shown in the UI or queries.

labels.symptom: The canvas or viewer looks blurred at 100% zoom and above instead of showing sharp pixels, especially at fractional display scaling.
labels.root_cause: The image rect was not snapped to the physical pixel grid and magnification used bilinear filtering.

labels.symptom: Native third-party effect plug-ins cannot be used safely.
At 29.97/59.94 fps, committing the timeline time field moves the playhead to a different frame.
labels.root_cause: Displayed time is non-drop timecode, but the parser reads it as drop-frame.

labels.symptom: After editing text and clicking elsewhere, typing and Space still go into the text instead of app shortcuts.
labels.root_cause: Edit only ended on viewer clicks and the viewer reclaimed keyboard focus whenever nothing else held it.

labels.symptom: Right-click menu actions on several selected layers apply to only one.
labels.root_cause: Context menu passed only the right-clicked layer id and reselected it.

labels.symptom: Sony ARW raw photos are imported as generic stills instead of developed sensor data.
labels.root_cause: No raw sensor decode path for ARW files in the media layer.

labels.symptom: A text range selector added from a script is ignored, and its Start, End and Offset properties return null.
